scope: Synthetic capacity-report identity and replay regression
reproduced_failures: Mixed environment accepted under the same reasoning binding
Mixed subject accepted under the same reasoning binding
Mixed goal accepted under the same reasoning binding
Repeated sample ID accepted with a different cycle label
repair: Require one environment/subject/goal and unique sample IDs before aggregation. Preserve revision and producer-epoch variation for separately verified reconnect evidence.
additional_checks: Epoch/revision variation does not imply a changed subject or goal
Repeated effect refs across samples still fail acceptance
limitations: Supplied identity strings are not authenticated by this pure reporter
Unique sample IDs do not prove real resident rolling extensions
Freshness, actual extension receipts and cross-clock evidence joins still require capture-side verification
